decisions.reason: It had dedicated presentation in both observed years and fits the firm's drainage-system resource base, so an established German specialist with some slack would likely retain it unless newer evidence showed a clear aspiration shortfall.
A floor-level shower drainage system is closely aligned with the firm's stated strategic direction and core customers, so management would be unlikely to withdraw it after only a short market test.

Even though its website prominence softened after launch, it was framed as a flagship design product and a firm following behavioral logic would usually give a strategically symbolic line more time if it remains directionally important.
This product complements the firm's integrated installation solutions for showers and renovations, so its likely role in a broader system portfolio makes retention more probable than exit.
Its strong launch communication and home-page visibility suggest performance at least near aspiration, and its technical differentiation gives management reason to keep it in the range.

Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly promoted and is somewhat more peripheral, it is the most plausible candidate for problemistic reallocation, but portfolio-complementarity still makes continued marketing slightly more likely than withdrawal.
